localisation_rmse_m.definition: Root-mean-square distance in metres between each fused track and the truth it was first paired with, over every frame the track exists.

track_continuity_mean.definition: Mean over targets of the fraction of steps in which the target has at least one accepted bearing observation.

covariance_reduction_mean.definition: Mean over tracks of (trace(P_first) - trace(P_last update)) / trace(P_first), the 3x3 position block; tracks qualify only with enough updates (D-1).

time_to_reacquire_mean_s.definition: Mean duration in seconds of track-loss events (stale steps > 0 until 0 again); an event never recovered counts to the end of the run.

mission_completion_rate.definition: Required objectives met over required objectives (1.0 when none are required).

energy_reserve_min.definition: Lowest battery fraction left on any drone at the end of the run.

false_handoff_rate.definition: Fraction of track handoffs that went to the wrong target.

safety_override_count.definition: Times the safety monitor overrode a commanded motion. Context-dependent: fewer can mean a safer plan or a less exercised monitor.
